milestones.description: Plan: 'deploy taxing hatebears (Thalia, ...)' — Thalia, Guardian of Thraben cast by turn 2.
Plan: 'deploy taxing hatebears (Thalia, Mother of Runes, Phyrexian Revoker)' — any of them by turn 2.
Decklist enabler for the plan's tempo grind ('grind on tempo'): Aether Vial on turn 1.
Plan: 'Lock their mana with Rishadan Port + Wasteland' — rate a denial activation is taken when offered.
Plan: 'suit up a threat with Stoneforge Mystic -> Batterskull/Jitte' — Stoneforge first, Batterskull/Jitte cast/used later in the game.
Plan: 'protect creatures with Mother of Runes' — a Mother of Runes cast/activation available while a threat is on board.
Plan: 'Swords to Plowshares removes their threats' — rate Swords is cast when offered.

notes: Mother of Runes protection activations render with the CAST prefix in these logs, so mom_protects counts casts and activations together.
fixtures_note: no logged games for this archetype yet; extractors covered by synthetic fixtures in test_plan_adherence.py
